desc:
🕯️ ESCAPE DA CAVE! 🕯️

You woke up in an old mine. The torches still burn... for now.

ACT 1 - THE UPPER TUNNELS
Follow the torches through a twisting maze. Read what the last expedition left behind. Don't trust the light at the end.

ACT 2 - THE DEEP
Fall into a pitch-black labyrinth where THE HOLLOW hunts you by sound and by light.
🔦 Your flashlight shows the way, but it also shows IT where you are
🏃 Sprinting is fast, but it can hear you
🚪 Hide in old mine lockers
🔥 It won't step into the torchlight
💎 Find 3 red gems to open the Old Gate... then RUN

⏱️ Beat your best time · 💀 Count your deaths · 📜 Find all 6 notes
👥 Play solo or with friends

👍 Like & ⭐ favorite if you made it out alive!
